rules.reason: Brown rice retains bran and germ, providing more fiber than refined white rice for the same grain role.
sources: USDA FoodData Central: brown rice vs white rice fiber comparison (https://fdc.nal.usda.gov/)
Dietary Guidelines for Americans — make half your grains whole (https://www.dietaryguidelines.gov/)

rules.reason: Replacing brown rice with white rice removes fiber-rich bran; refined grains are less aligned with DGA whole-grain guidance.
sources: Dietary Guidelines for Americans — whole grains (https://www.dietaryguidelines.gov/)

rules.reason: Sugar-sweetened soft drinks add empty calories and added sugars without the protein of plain yogurt.
sources: FDA Added Sugars on the Nutrition Facts label (https://www.fda.gov/food/nutrition-facts-label/added-sugars-nutrition-facts-label)
Dietary Guidelines for Americans — limit added sugars (https://www.dietaryguidelines.gov/)

rules.reason: Firm tofu is a lean plant protein alternative with less saturated fat than many animal proteins when prepared simply.
sources: USDA FoodData Central — tofu / chicken nutrient profiles (https://fdc.nal.usda.gov/)
Dietary Guidelines for Americans — vary protein sources (https://www.dietaryguidelines.gov/)

rules.reason: Lard is higher in saturated fat than olive oil; DGA encourages shifting toward oils higher in unsaturated fat. Lard is also non-vegetarian.
sources: Dietary Guidelines for Americans — oils and saturated fat (https://www.dietaryguidelines.gov/)

rules.reason: Avocado contributes unsaturated fats and fiber; sour cream adds saturated fat and milk allergen without comparable fiber.
sources: Dietary Guidelines for Americans — dietary fats (https://www.dietaryguidelines.gov/)

rules.reason: Corn tortillas avoid wheat (major allergen) when labeled 100% corn and are typically lower in sodium than many flour tortillas.
sources: FDA Food Allergen Labeling (FALCPA / FASTER Act) major allergens (https://www.fda.gov/food/food-allergensgluten-free-guidance-documents-regulatory-information/food-allergen-labeling-and-consumer-protection-act-2004-falcpa)
